About this book
This book gives one full practice test for children who are getting ready for the Pre A1
Starters exam, usually aged 6 to 8. It is the second test in the Jurassic English Starters
series and has its own pictures and words.
It has a Reading and Writing paper (5 parts, 25 questions, 20 minutes), a Listening
paper (4 parts, 20 questions, about 20 minutes, with audio), a Speaking pack (4 parts, 3
to 5 minutes) and a teacher’s Answer Key with audio scripts, marks and a mark sheet.
How to use it. Sit the papers one at a time, in a quiet room. Play each listening part
twice. Then mark with the key and write the marks on the mark sheet.
[Vietnamese line: to be written and read by a native speaker before print.]
